product_identity.description: Generic rules/reference object rather than a specific commercial model.
Made or configured to order rather than normal shelf stock.
Singular or exceptional object not treated as a repeatable product line.

commodity_kinds.description: Physical stock consumed or depleted through use.
Product normally fitted or installed into a person, property or system.
Part, attachment or upgrade used with another product or system.
Digital software, application, program, Black ICE or comparable code.
One-off or continuously available service rather than physical stock.
Housing, property or comparable fixed asset.
Item or currency existing inside an in-world virtual environment.

quantity_profiles.description: Usually zero or one unit at a particular seller.
Normally traded or replenished in volume.
Finite stock count is not meaningful, as with services or replicable software.

conditions.description: Used product restored or reconditioned for sale.
Product with meaningful wear, damage or impairment.
Recovered or scavenged product with uncertain history.

supply_profiles.description: Appropriate sellers can source it almost automatically.
Requires an appropriate specialist supplier or channel.
Irregular even for an appropriate seller.
Normally sourced, configured or made to order.

market_channels.description: Corporate dealership, direct corporate supply or controlled brand channel.
Professional procurement such as medical, security or industrial supply.
Questionable or unofficial trade that is not necessarily fully clandestine.
Primarily ordered directly from producer, fabricator or specialist supplier.
